# clearml_resource_profile (Data Source)

Looks up one vendor-provisioned ClearML resource profile by exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "clearml_resource_profile" "gpu_small" {
  name = "gpu-small"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `cost_field` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `profile_cost` (Number)
